# Claim units fixture

Claim A: The coolant loop fails closed when pressure drops below 2.1 bar.
Claim B: Crew must don EVA suits within ninety seconds of a hull alarm.
Claim C: The backup radio channel is labeled QUARTZ-DELTA on the wrist pad.

Each claim is one sentence so claim-centered chunking can keep them atomic.
A recursive splitter with a tiny budget may still split mid-claim — that is
the failure mode these tests watch for.
